title: AI Policy Language for Students
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting ai policy language for students to AI-USE disclosure excerpt tied to one bounded design-support decision, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Contrast deterrence and transparency models of academic integrity and explain why generative AI makes deterrence unenforceable
Write an AI-use clause with a bounded permission, a one-line disclosure format with a worked example, and an accessibility carve-out
Apply the distinguishability, disclosure-cost, and accessibility checks to evaluate a draft AI-use policy
Predict the behavioral effect (concealment, exclusion, or transparency) a policy clause will produce

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
